detached_structure.evidence: A small blue-roofed object sits just south of the main house near the driveway. It could be a small shed or a covered vehicle or equipment.

signals.notes: The central house has a brown/tan shingle roof with some discoloration and a dirt/gravel driveway on the east side of the lot. The backyard is open lawn with a garden area and the lot is bordered by mature trees, with a drainage ditch along the east edge.
